correctness.rationale: For the six permutation vertices of B3, the unique primitive toric relation equates products of even and odd triple coordinates, so X=V(x1x2x3−y1y2y3) in P5. Its partials are precisely all pair products within each triple, and the squarefree saturated Jacobian ideal is the K3,3 Stanley–Reisner ideal; hence precisely 9 coordinate lines with 6 triple-point intersections, no embedded components. Tensoring two coordinate-axis rings gives Hilbert series (1+2t)^2/(1−t)^2, Hilbert polynomial 9d−3, degree 9, genus 4, CM. Jacobian codimension >=2 and hypersurface CM establish normality. Generic line chart is transverse uv−wz=0, local class group Z; six endpoint charts ab−cde=0 have six invariant height-one divisors, a rank-4 saturated relation lattice, hence Cl(local)=Z². Independently checked all 6-variable singular support masks, Hilbert pieces through degree24 and rank+gcd maximal minors=1 for six-divisor relation matrix; verified actual assigned full RESULT and checker paths.

Its singular scheme, arithmetic genus, and a jump from rank-one to rank-two local class groups at six triple intersections give natural geometric invariants useful when studying divisors, Q-factoriality and possible resolutions. Exact specialization is substantive beyond repeating the original cubic relation.
